:::{#def-error-rate}
#### Error rate (misclassification rate)

The **error rate** of a [fitted model](#def-fitted-model) $\fitted$
for a [categorical](data.qmd#def-categorical-var) outcome on a set of observations
is the [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) of the [loss](#def-observation-loss)
under 0-1 loss,
$\lossf{\outvar, \eoutvar} = \indic{\outvar \neq \eoutvar}$,
which is 1 for a wrong [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) and 0 for a correct one.
The error rate is the proportion of observations in the set whose predicted category differs from the observed category.

:::
